explication: Cutter is a Qt desktop reverse-engineering platform powered by Rizin. The principal workflow is to open a binary, analyze it, and inspect or modify the resulting code and program data; debugging and extensibility are substantial supporting capabilities. The tree and README establish the major subsystems, but most of their implementation was not sampled, so the graph omits uncertain internal wiring rather than implying a detailed call sequence.
